item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Creates `dspy.Predict(\"question -> answer\")` and awaits four `program.acall(question=...)` calls together via one `asyncio.gather(...)`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `SlowDummyLM(DummyLM)` with async `aforward` that does `await asyncio.sleep(0.2)` before delegating to `super().forward(...)`, giving offline async latency."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Seeds deterministic `Q1`-`Q4` to `A1`-`A4` mappings, collects `result.answer` from gathered results, and asserts the expected answer list."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Times only the gathered batch with `perf_counter()` and asserts `elapsed < 0.6`, which is well below the 0.8s serial total for four 0.2s sleeps, demonstrating overlap."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
